<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Stupid Fish 62</title>
<style>
/* From Uiverse.io by cjnoise - https://uiverse.io/cjnoise/stupid-fish-62 */
/* From Uiverse.io by cjnoise  - Tags: blue, button, animated, 3d button */
.button {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  font-size: 16px;
  text-align: center;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid #3498db;
  color: #fff;
  background-color: #3498db;
  border-radius: 5px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.button::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  transform: perspective(5px) rotateX(2deg) rotateY(2deg);
  transition: transform 0.3s;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.button:hover::before {
  transform: perspective(5px) rotateX(0) rotateY(0);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">Button</button>
</body>
</html>
